title: Rubi Trade Work
description: This mod add Rubi , Rubi Block , Rubi ore , Deepslate Rubi ore and fully functional Rubi Block Beacon. this mod loads on Fabric 0.16.14.
body:
Rubi Mod adds a brand new ruby-themed experience to Minecraft! Mine deep underground to discover powerful Rubi Ore and Deepslate Rubi Ore. Smelt and collect shiny Rubi gems, craft Rubi Blocks, Rubi Coins, crowns, and strong red Rubi armor.

Features:

New Rubi Ore generation underground
Deepslate Rubi Ore variant
Rubi gems and Rubi Coins
Rubi Block for storage and decoration
Powerful Rubi Helmet and future armor set
Special crafting recipes
Minecraft styled red textures
Diamond Pickaxe required to mine Rubi Ore

This mod keeps the vanilla Minecraft feeling while adding a fresh ruby-themed progression system. Perfect for survival worlds, adventures, and custom modpacks!
